template.name: Human Fighter Template
template.description: A versatile human warrior, perfect for new players. Strong in combat with good survivability.

racial.name: Extra Language
racial.description: You can speak, read, and write one extra language of your choice.

racial.name: Extra Skill
racial.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

class.name: Fighting Style
class.description: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.
class.effect: +1 bonus to AC while wearing armor

class.name: Second Wind
class.description: You have a limited well of stamina that you can draw on to protect yourself from harm.
class.usage: Once per short or long rest

background.name: Military Rank
background.description: You have a military rank from your career as a soldier. Soldiers loyal to your former military organization still recognize your authority and influence.

traits: I'm always respectful to those in positions of authority.
I've faced down dragons and demons, but a simple insect makes me nervous.
ideals: Courage: I never back down from a worthy challenge.
bonds: I would still lay down my life for those I served with in my old unit.
flaws: I have little respect for anyone who is not a proven warrior.

backstory.summary: A former soldier who served in the realm's army, now seeking adventure and purpose after completing military service. Skilled in combat and tactics, with a strong sense of duty and honor.
keyEvents: Enlisted in the army at age 16
Served in border conflicts against orc raiders
Earned recognition for bravery in battle
Completed term of service and received honorable discharge
Now seeks new purpose as an adventurer
connections: Former commanding officer who may provide missions
Fellow veterans scattered across the realm
Family members proud of military service

level2.notes: Action Surge allows an additional action on your turn

level3.notes: Critical hits occur on rolls of 19-20

level4.recommendations: Increase Strength to 18 or take a feat like Great Weapon Master

level5.notes: Can make two attacks when taking the Attack action

combat: Use longsword two-handed for 1d10 damage when not using a shield
Throw javelins at distant enemies before closing to melee
Use Second Wind when below half health
At level 2, use Action Surge for critical moments or extra attacks
exploration: Intimidation for social encounters with hostile NPCs
Military background provides connections and knowledge
social: Take charge in combat situations due to military training
Can relate to other soldiers and guards

personalityOptions.veteranWarrior: Haunted by past battles but determined
personalityOptions.nobleDefender: Fights for justice and the innocent
personalityOptions.pragmaticSoldier: Practical approach to problems and combat
